borrowed_disaster.text: The borrowed zip bursts as you sit in the Prado. Musa pretends not to hear.
borrowed_disaster.receipt: Your Bestie's borrowed outfit split on the way.

lines.text: Babe. BABE. Are you sure about this Chief?
59 years. Red cap. Tinted Prado. Somebody's husband energy.

replies.label: "He's sweet. Let me enjoy."

lines.text: Sweet like sugar. Sugar causes diabetes. Enjoy.

replies.receipt: You told your Bestie Chief is sweet.

replies.label: "Call me at 10. If I don't pick, come."

lines.text: 10pm. I'm setting alarm. I have Uber money ready.

replies.receipt: You set up a 10pm safety call with your Bestie.

replies.label: "Na the bag I dey find."

lines.text: Then don't come back with only a voice note.

replies.receipt: You told your Bestie it's about the bag.

missed.label: Let it ring
missed.receipt: You let your Bestie's call ring out.

driver_lines.text: Good evening, {title}. Oga is waiting. Seatbelt, please.
The bridge is free tonight. God is working.

steps.partner_text: Leave your phone in your bag tonight. No pictures.

put_away.label: Phone into the bag
put_away.receipt: You put your phone away like Chief asked.

keep_out.label: Keep it in your hand
keep_out.receipt: You kept your phone out, despite Chief's text.

steps.prompt: The terrace. Where do you sit?

seats.label: Window, lagoon view
seats.receipt: You chose the window table with the lagoon view.

seats.label: Corner booth
seats.receipt: You chose the private corner booth.

high.text: Ehen! You dressed for me. Turn around, let me see.

low.text: Next time, let my tailor dress you. Sit down.

lines.text: So. Tell me. What does a person like you want from a man like me?

replies.label: "Honesty. Can you afford it?"

lines.text: Hmm. Honesty is expensive in Lagos. I'll see what I have.

replies.receipt: You asked Chief for honesty on the first date.

replies.label: "Your time. And your attention."

lines.text: My time is very expensive. For you, discount.

replies.receipt: You flirted your way through the first question.

replies.label: "Let's start with dinner. Then we talk."

lines.text: A negotiator. My kind of person.

replies.receipt: You told Chief to start with dinner.

unseen.text: Snap. 2,000 views by dessert. Nobody saw. Yet.

seen.text: Flash. He sees. 'I said no pictures.'
seen.receipt: Chief caught you photographing his Rolex.

lines.text: Raise your glass. To new things.

perfect.text: Clink. He holds your eye a second too long.

good.text: Clink. Nice. He smiles into his wine.

spill.text: Wine on his agbada. He laughs. Mostly.
spill.receipt: You spilled wine on Chief's agbada.

steps.lead: His phone lights up. Face up. He reaches for it.

replies.label: Read it
replies.text: You read it before his thumb covers it.
replies.receipt: You read the name on Chief's phone.

replies.label: Flip it face down for him
replies.text: He squeezes your hand. Grateful. Very grateful.
replies.receipt: You flipped his phone face down for him.

replies.label: Look at the lagoon
replies.text: The lagoon is lovely. The phone was lovelier.
replies.receipt: You looked away from Chief's phone.

timeout.text: Too slow. He pockets it, smiling.
timeout.receipt: You missed the name on Chief's phone.

lead.text: I must take this. Two minutes. Don't run away.

serial_sponsor.receipt: You found his allowance list in the briefcase.

broke.text: A blank guarantor line. Waiting for a name. Yours?
broke.receipt: You found a guarantor form in his briefcase.

divorced.text: Friday 7pm to Monday. His weekends belong to someone.
divorced.receipt: You found court papers about his weekends.

caught.text: 'Found what you're looking for?' He was standing there the whole time.
caught.receipt: Chief caught you inside his briefcase.

skipped.text: You leave it alone. He comes back to an innocent face.

back.text: Sorry. Business never sleeps. Where were we?

serial_sponsor.label: Her wrist
serial_sponsor.text: A gold bracelet. Same box as the one in his glovebox.

broke.label: The sign behind them
broke.text: 'APAPA CLEARING AGENTS'. He's smiling. She isn't.

divorced.label: The banner
divorced.text: 'PRIZE-GIVING DAY'. A school event. Two kids at the edge of the frame.

replies.label: Show Chief the photo

serial_sponsor.text: That? My cousin. Lagos is full of my cousins.

divorced.text: That's my ex-wife. At my children's school. I'll tell you everything.

replies.receipt: You showed Chief the photo at the table.

replies.label: Forward it to your Bestie

lines.text: Who sent this?! Babe. Eat your food and watch.

replies.receipt: You forwarded the photo to your Bestie.

replies.label: Delete it. Not tonight.
replies.receipt: You deleted the photo without a word.

broke.name: Mrs Coker
broke.line: Emeka! You said you were in Abuja. You owe me.

escaped.text: Through the kitchen, past a man gutting fish. You're on Bourdillon Road. Alive.
escaped.receipt: You escaped her through the kitchen.

outlasted.text: She gives up and storms out. Chief wipes his forehead. 'Business.'
outlasted.receipt: You stayed hidden until she left.

filmed.text: You got out. But her friend's phone caught you crawling. It's online.

worse.text: CRASH. You took out a waiter's tray. Every head turns. Including hers.
worse.receipt: You knocked over a tray while hiding from her.

serial_sponsor.text: 'You. Stand up.' Mama Ugo looks you over like a new maid. 'Number four.'
serial_sponsor.receipt: His first wife caught you hiding.

broke.text: 'Are you his new bank?' Mrs Coker hands you her card. 'Call me when he asks.'
broke.receipt: The woman he owes caught you hiding.

divorced.text: Nkechi finds you behind the bar. 'Why are you hiding? I'm the ex.' Oh.
divorced.receipt: His ex-wife found you hiding behind the bar.

serial_sponsor.text: You walk up. She smiles. 'Brave. They're usually under the table.'
serial_sponsor.receipt: You walked straight up to his first wife.

broke.text: 'He owes me twelve million.' She says it to you. Chief studies the menu.
broke.receipt: You faced the woman he owes.

divorced.text: 'Relax. I'm the ex. He snores and forgets birthdays. Good luck.'
divorced.receipt: You introduced yourself to his ex-wife.

serial_sponsor.text: 'My cousin from the East,' Chief says. You smile. You are now his cousin.
serial_sponsor.receipt: You let Chief introduce you as his cousin.

broke.text: She sits at your table and orders. On his tab. He goes grey.
broke.receipt: You sat through his creditor joining your dinner.

divorced.text: She drops a school bag on the table. 'Saturday, 9am.' Leaves. That's it.
divorced.receipt: You stayed calm while his ex dropped off the kids' bag.

serial_sponsor.text: You take his hand. She sees. The whole terrace sees. Chief does not.
serial_sponsor.receipt: You held Chief's hand in front of his wife.

broke.text: 'Ah, so you're the new investor.' She slides an invoice towards you.
broke.receipt: You held his hand in front of the woman he owes.

divorced.text: Nkechi raises an eyebrow, then a thumbs up. Chief squeezes back.
divorced.receipt: You held Chief's hand in front of his ex-wife.

escaped.text: Sorry about tonight. Musa is outside. Let me make it up to you.

outlasted.text: You're still here. Good. Very good.

filmed.text: Don't post anything. I'll handle it. I always handle it.

worse.text: Next time, sit still. I'll send Musa.

caught.text: She talks too much. Forget her. Get home safe.

faced.text: You have liver. I don't know if I like it.

stayed.text: You handled that well. Very well.

envelope.text: An envelope in the Prado: 'For transport.' It is not transport money.
envelope.receipt: Chief sent you home with an envelope.

envelope_broke.text: An envelope in the Prado. ₦40k in mixed notes. 'Something bigger next week.'
envelope_broke.receipt: Chief's envelope was smaller than his promises.

steps.teaser: Tomorrow: Chief wants to know where you were at 10pm.
